notes: Text for the reason codes in providers/mysql_family/refusal_codes.py. A test requires an entry for every code and none for an unregistered one. A refusal whose message is fixed text in source is shown as that text (or its reworded form, refusal_wording.json) with the code rule_not_met.

refusals.message: A required value is missing. Fill in the indicated field, or see the SQL tab for what the operation needs.
A grid or list has the wrong shape. Add rows with the grid's Add button, one value per row.
A number is missing or outside the allowed range. Enter a whole number the field allows, for example 10.
This field takes a yes or no choice. Use its switch or checkbox.
The value is not one the field offers. Choose one of the values in its list.
The value is not in the expected format. Check it against the field's help text.
A value is too long. MySQL limits most names to 64 characters.
A name or reference is not in a form MySQL accepts. Use name or schema.table, for example shop.orders.
The text contains syntax the plan will not carry, such as a statement separator or a comment. Use one plain expression.
The SQL could not be parsed. Check it for typos and unbalanced quotes or brackets; an administrator can read the details with the reference.
A value appears more than once or already exists. Each one must be distinct.
This operation needs a newer MySQL version than the connected server.
This cannot be changed once it exists. Drop it and create it again to change it.
The name you gave is not part of this object. Check the spelling against the object's current contents.
A secret cannot be carried in a plan. Set it from the server's Properties dialog or use the protected delivery the operation offers.
This kind of object or operation is not handled here. Use the object's own node in the tree.
MySQL, or one of its utilities, rejected this. An administrator can read its message with the reference.
The outcome of an earlier operation is not known. Check the server before trying again; an administrator can read the details with the reference.
The file content is not in the expected format. Check the lines the file needs.
A rule of this operation is not met. See the SQL tab, or ask an administrator to read the details with the reference.
The provider could not complete this just now. Try again; an administrator can read the details with the reference.
What you are working on has changed or is out of date. Refresh the tree and try again.
The name you typed does not match the object's name. Type it exactly as shown, for example orders, to confirm.
A password is never carried in a plan or SQL preview. Set it with the protected delivery the operation offers.
Choose the database this runs in. It only affects the objects of that database.
This operation needs your confirmation. Tick or fill in the confirmation the dialog asks for.
